spec: §15 suite B; §3.7 suite-B sentence: one forward lift.call step of a recursive call followed by its inverse restores the complete pre-step tuple and every frame field is clean; §3.6 inverse step; §5.2 commit of a non-halted prefix is (0, FAULT_BUDGET_STEPS)
derivation: For sum_db n=1 the executed rows are: oracle addr,const,call (3), then sum addr,boundscheck,load,icmp,qbranch (8), more-block const,sub,zext,add,boundscheck,load,add (15), so row 16 is the recursive lift.call. Running 16 steps and 16 inverse steps restores the entry tuple: pc 0, counters heap_used 0, atop 2 (the two pinned pre-entries of §16.3), sp/fp/depth 0, pseudo-location sum_db.n still 1; F_16 is not halted so payload 0 code 1.
